annotations.title: Save a new set to the user's account

description: Use this when the user is signed in and a set you made is ready: after finish_project (and any update_project), or create_design (and any update_design), once the previews look right. Saves it straight into their appdesigns library, into the project you named with project_id or same_project_as (else a new project named after it), with no link to open and nothing for them to press. Returns the saved asset_id and revision for edit_asset, and open_url, which opens the saved set in the editor. The draft's own link then opens the saved set. Needs the user signed in to appdesigns; a call without it fails asking for sign-in, and then the user signs in (in Claude Code type /mcp, pick appdesigns and choose Authenticate (or run `claude mcp login appdesigns` in a separate terminal), in Codex run `codex mcp login appdesigns`; other agents open the sign-in page themselves).

handle.description: The project_handle create_project returned, or the design_handle create_design returned.
